items: USPS final rule sets 5.9% increase. The Postal Service published a final rule setting competitive product prices effective January 17, 2027. Priority Mail Express, Priority Mail and USPS Ground Advantage rise 5.9% overall, Parcel Select Destination Entry rises an average of 5.9%, and several extra and mailer service fees rise 8.0% to 9.1%.

UPS and FedEx lift Ground minimum charge. An industry analysis says UPS raises its Ground minimum 5.92%, from $11.99 to $12.70, on Dec. 21, 2026, and FedEx raises its minimums on Jan. 4, 2027. Both carriers set the Ground minimum at $12.70, which can keep lightweight packages at or near list price.

GLS and Geopost announce German parcel joint venture. GLS Group and Geopost announced a joint venture covering their German parcel businesses, according to a Reuters headline carried by TradingView. The available text gives no financial terms, timeline or service details.
